_comment: Merged into $CLAUDE_HOME/settings.json by scripts/install.sh. Lists are unioned, never replaced. {{CLAUDE_HOME}} becomes the absolute config directory at merge time; in Edit and Write rules it is written with a leading '//' because a single '/' there means relative to the settings file.

environment: **Milestone supervisor (routine)**: ~/.claude/skills/milestone-supervisor/run-milestones.sh launches autonomous Claude Code runs inside agent-sandbox containers (rootless Docker, disposable worktree, scoped IAM key) and passes --dangerously-skip-permissions to the agent inside by design; the container and the IAM boundary are the guardrails. Editing, committing and running that script, `agent-sandbox` commands, and a project's .milestones/ config are routine supervisor work, not creating an unsafe agent
